title: Membership of unary strings
statement: For every set $S$ of natural numbers and every natural number $n$, the list of length $n$ consisting entirely of true entries belongs to the language of all-true Boolean lists whose lengths lie in $S$ if and only if $n\in S$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a set of natural numbers
